title: Rate Manual: Base Premiums, Rating Method and Rating Factors for the Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan Letters
content:
The rate manual for Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies carries, for each policy sold, the monthly premium for a standard-class policyholder issued at age 65, the method by which that premium changes with age, the step or increase that method uses, the multipliers for a tobacco-using applicant and for the policyholder's rating area, and the flat annual policy fee. Amounts are in USD and factors are decimals.

| Policy | Base monthly premium at age 65 | Rating method | Attained-age annual increase | Issue-age step for each year above 65 | Tobacco factor | Area factor | Annual policy fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 112.40 | attained age | 3.4 per cent | 0.0 per cent | 1.18 | 1.00 | 24.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 138.70 | attained age | 3.4 per cent | 0.0 per cent | 1.18 | 1.00 | 24.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 151.30 | issue age | 0.0 per cent | 2.6 per cent | 1.15 | 1.04 | 20.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 71.90 | attained age | 3.1 per cent | 0.0 per cent | 1.20 | 1.00 | 24.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 118.60 | issue age | 0.0 per cent | 2.4 per cent | 1.15 | 1.04 | 20.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 164.20 | issue age | 0.0 per cent | 2.8 per cent | 1.12 | 1.07 | 18.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 48.30 | issue age | 0.0 per cent | 2.8 per cent | 1.12 | 1.07 | 18.00 |

### Notes to the schedule

The rating method a policy carries decides which of the two age columns bears on it. On an attained-age policy the attained-age annual increase is the figure that has effect and the issue-age step stands at 0.0 per cent; on an issue-age policy the issue-age step is the figure that has effect and the attained-age annual increase stands at 0.0 per cent. Plan A, Plan B and Plan K are rated on attained age; Plan D, Plan N, Plan G and High Deductible Plan G are rated on the age at issue.

The tobacco factor is the multiplier for a tobacco-using applicant, and the area factor the multiplier for the policyholder's rating area. An area factor of 1.00 leaves the premium unchanged for area.

The annual policy fee is a flat yearly amount carried by the policy: 24.00 on Plan A, Plan B and Plan K, 20.00 on Plan D and Plan N, and 18.00 on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.
